t: Ring ULTRAinflate 20 is a 12V digital tyre inflator designed for fast, precise and easy inflation. Features a high-precision digital gauge and real-time progress meter, to allow accurate monitoring in PSI, BAR, or kPa. The intelligent auto-stop function halts inflation at the desired pressure, while memory recall stores previous settings for convenience. A retractable 3m power cord, 60cm air hose and onboard storage for 3 nozzle types allow versatile use in various applications, such as cars, bikes, and sports equipment. The built-in valve cap holder prevents loss during inflation. Capable of inflating a 13” tyre in approximately 3.5 minutes.
